description: Konstan bell ratios INFERRED (no bell captures; build_preset.py): the mean bell-vs-bow tilt of Nova, Raven and Bettis (BELL_RULE), eased below 1.5 kHz, tilted so the centroid is 0.7 x the bow's, with a per-mode scatter from Nova's and Raven's (BELL_SCATTER_Q, seed 3) widened to BELL_CONCENTRATION; normalised to the strongest mode
